name: voice-guard
description: function hooks that keep Scott's mechanical voice rules at the tool boundary: a literal em-dash (U+2014) in written content, a commit or gh body, or an outward post is denied. Runs in shadow mode (judge, log, pass through) until enforce is turned on

enforce.title: enforce
enforce.description: When on, a match returns a deny and ends the chain. When off (shadow mode) the mod judges, logs and passes through, so the settings hook beneath decides.

deny_outward.title: deny_outward
deny_outward.description: Space-separated rule ids of the new phrase table promoted from warn to deny on outward tool calls (Slack, Jira, Confluence, Marquee, create_pr, commit and gh bodies). Only deny-outward rules can be named; in shadow mode a match is logged and never returned. Default empty: every rule warns. The schema has no array type, so the list is one string. Underscore because the plugin schema rejects hyphens in these keys.

warn_structural.title: warn_structural
warn_structural.description: When on, the structural warn rules run over outward posts (logged) and over the final reply, whose warning is shown beneath the answer. Never blocks.
